the defect chemistry and lithium storage performance in TiO  2 as a function oxygen stoichiometry and the implications for the use of TiO   2 as an electrode material in lithium ion batteries.
the defect chemistry of lithium in TiO  2, which is a key material in lithium ion batteries.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the oxygen stoichiometry is the key parameter that controls lithium storage properties in TiO  2.
oxygen stoichiometry and defect chemistry of lithium battery electrode materials can be of great importance to their performance.
lithium storage performance of an oxide electrode can be significantly enhanced by controlling oxygen stoichiometry and/or defect chemistry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

oxygen stoichiometry and its associated defect chemistry play a significant role for lithium storage in oxide based materials and should be considered for the development and optimization of lithium battery materials.

lithium storage in Ti-based oxides, including TiO 2, is governed by a complex interplay of oxygen nonstoichiometry, lithium content, and activity, and the defect chemistry of the system is a key to understand and optimize lithium storage properties of these materials.
oxygen stoichiometry is a key factor in controlling the defect chemistry of TiO 2 as a lithium storage material, and hence is of critical importance for optimizing lithium storage performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
defect chemistry of lithium insertion materials can be understood in terms of a simple defect model and that oxygen stoichiometry can have a large impact on lithium storage performance.

defect chemistry can be a powerful tool to understand the complex interplay between lithium content, oxygen stoichiometry and charge carrier concentration, and hence can be used to guide the rational design of high-performance lithium battery materials.
the oxygen stoichiometry is a crucial parameter to control defect chemistry and thus the performance of lithium storage.
